pulse_2016_2017.interpretation: A synchronized local recorded-state turnover pulse, not yet demographic extinction/recolonization or a climate-causal result.

finite_memory.comparison: strict walk-forward; baseline and augmented fitted/scored on identical rows for each memory candidate

claim_boundary: The annual recorded Thalassia state contains strong finite temporal information.
The 2016 loss and 2017 return are exploratory data-derived pulse findings.
Recorded non-detection is not equated with biological absence.
The 2016 pulse is not equated with the later bay-wide acreage decline.
